title: Charging toward sustainability: MgCl2 doped chitosan–dextran polyblend electrolytes for energy storage device applications
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,37045-37061
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06365A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Pradeep Nayak, Ismayil, Y. N. Sudhakar, Supriya K. Shetty
This study introduces a biodegradable SBPE made from dextran, chitosan, and MgCl2, suitable for Mg-ion batteries and EDLCs. It exhibits excellent ionic conductivity with XRD, and dielectric analysis highlighting ion-polyblend interactions.
